_readme: ETIM mapping. RULE (prompt §0.2): no ETIM code enters this repo without the viewer URL it was
read from, recorded next to it. An invented class code propagates into every record and is
worse than a blank. Blanks here are honest; guesses would not be.
Standing decision: the netzspec Field Schema Registry is canonical. ETIM is a MAPPING COLUMN,
not the backbone. EC000734 carries 37 features, all electrical-wholesale grade - no forwarding
rate, no switching capacity, no MAC table, no packet buffer, no operating temperature, no
weight, no MTBF. It cannot express a site whose entire pitch is Icecat-class depth.
Verified our side [M 2026-09-01]: scraper/probe_sources.py fetched the viewer class page,
HTTP 200, 42,563 bytes, EF-codes present in the DOM.
